title: 晨光列車 / First Light Express

shots.name: Cold open: rain on the window
shots.beat: Night. Raindrops run down a dark apartment window; neon from the street below smears into bokeh. The title 晨光列車 breathes in over the glass. A hand (Yuki) touches the pane.

shots.name: Rooftop over the city
shots.beat: Wide. Yuki stands on an apartment rooftop under a clear umbrella, looking at an endless neon city in the rain. Rain streaks, distant lights pulse, a plane blinks across the sky.

shots.name: Her decision
shots.beat: Close-up, low angle. Rain beads on the umbrella rim. Yuki looks up, exhales, and closes the umbrella in one motion. Rain hits her hair; she doesn't flinch.

shots.name: The platform
shots.beat: Station platform at night, wet concrete mirroring the lights. Headlights grow from the dark; the First Light Express slides in with mist and a soft hiss. Doors open, warm light spills out.

shots.name: Window seat
shots.beat: Train interior. Yuki sits by the window, bag on her lap. The city lights streak past as the train accelerates; her reflection floats over the glass.

shots.name: Bridge over the city
shots.beat: Exterior wide, slightly high. The lit train crosses a long steel bridge over the river; the city's towers glitter behind. Camera slowly cranes up and back.

shots.name: Falling asleep
shots.beat: Interior close-up. Yuki's eyes grow heavy; the neon outside fades to dark countryside; only the carriage lamps glow. She rests her head against the glass. Fade out.

shots.name: Out of the tunnel
shots.beat: Blue hour. The train bursts from a tunnel into the countryside; mist lies in sheets over rice fields; the sky is deep indigo bleeding to rose at the horizon. Camera tracks alongside.

shots.name: Mountain dawn
shots.beat: Epic wide. Layered mountain silhouettes, a sky gradient from indigo to gold; the sun's first rays break over a ridge in god rays. The train is a tiny lit thread along the valley.

shots.name: Waking in sunlight
shots.beat: Interior. A bar of golden light sweeps across Yuki's face as the train turns; she wakes, blinks, and sits up. Window frames and passing poles strobe gently across her.

shots.name: Cherry blossom lane
shots.beat: Exterior along the track: rows of sakura in full bloom. The train passes through and petals explode into the air, swirling in the wake. Camera drifts with the petals, slow and dreamy.

shots.name: The letter
shots.beat: Insert, over the shoulder. Yuki unfolds a letter in her hands, reads it, then folds it carefully into a paper plane. Sunlight and petal shadows move across the paper.

shots.name: Coast reveal
shots.beat: Exterior. The train rounds a cliff and the sea opens up, impossibly wide and bright. Camera cranes up from track level to reveal the whole coastline and the morning sun on the water.

shots.name: Seaside station
shots.beat: A tiny seaside station. Yuki steps down onto the platform, bag over her shoulder; wind catches her hair; gulls wheel overhead. The train pulls away behind her.

shots.name: To the water's edge
shots.beat: Beach. Yuki walks down the sand to where the waves run in; low sun, long shadow. She stops at the edge of the foam and takes out the paper plane.

shots.name: The throw
shots.beat: She throws the paper plane. Camera follows it out over the water, low and fast, catching sun glints on the waves, then rising as the plane climbs into the light.

shots.name: New day
shots.beat: Wide sunrise over the sea; the plane is a speck against the sun; lens flare blooms; Yuki small on the beach. The words 新的一天 appear and dissolve. Fade to white.

shots.name: Credits
shots.beat: Credits card on black: 晨光列車 · First Light Express. Directed by one agent; built by seven departments in parallel; pure Three.js; 18 shots; 1,896 frames. Fade to black.
